_comment: Building specs: markets, mills, prestige buildings, mitigation infrastructure. Filled in during Phase 2.

tradingHouse._note: Unlocked at Count (rank 3, see data/ranks.json unlockedFeature). Was Margrave (4) until the D2 commerce calibration — Merchant/Raider typically plateau near Count with high treasury and low population, so a Margrave-gated unlock meant the Commerce alt path for ranks 5-7 was unreachable for the archetypes it was meant to serve. Income is sized so a single trading house roughly breaks even against the wealth-proportional tribute (economy.json upkeep.tradingHouseTributePercentage) at typical mid-game treasuries, then falls behind as wealth grows — the anti-snowball shape every other late-game building follows.

cathedral._note: Tied to Archbishop Prestige-path populationMin in data/ranks.json (2600) — the first rank that requires cathedral:true. Was 5000 (B1, unreachable), then 2800 (still above Archbishop's stated threshold — B5). Keep this equal to (or below) that rank's populationMin whenever ranks are recalibrated.

_mitigationNote: `mitigates` is documentation of intent; the authoritative mitigation coefficients live per-event in data/events.json (an event owns its own risk formula). Kept in sync by validateEventCatalog(), which fails if an event names a mitigation building that doesn't exist here.

dike._note: F6: flood's dedicated mitigation building — deliberately NOT shared with well/drought, so a ruler on flood-prone (wet-weather) exposure faces a real, separate investment rather than one building covering both ends of the weather distribution for free.
